skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Upload path — hand over one checklist' requires 'Financial statements for the period and the comparative', but references/method.md 'Step 3 — Draft account-detail notes' ties notes to 'the BS/IS face'; on an upload run with only TBs the skill does not say whether the TB may stand in for the face, so the tie-out is to the TB by improvisation.

references/method.md 'Step 3' says to check comparatives 'against what was filed', but gives no instruction when the only prior-year document is an extract whose figures disagree with the prior-year TB (which source the comparative column should show while unresolved).

SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' row B asks the period and issue date separately but nothing checks that they are consistent (a 30 Sep 2025 period issued 20 Mar 2026 suggests annual accounts); references/method.md 'Step 6' assumes they describe one reporting date.

references/method.md 'Step 1 — Build the disclosure checklist' scopes notes from 'the chart and the balance sheet' ('No debt, no debt note'), which would rule out a lease note when a lease exists off-balance-sheet; the scoping rule needs to include commitments named in prior notes.
sample_defects: prior_year_notes_extract.md Note 4 accumulated depreciation 197,800 vs trial_balance_2024-12-31.csv 273,400 (diff 75,600 = 18 x 4,200); Note 7 term loan 445,000 vs TB 265,000 (565,000 - 60 x 5,000 = 265,000; 445,000 = 565,000 - 24 x 5,000, i.e. Dec 2021). Unflagged by the key.
Prior-year notes disclose a warehouse lease to 2028 but neither TB carries an ROU asset or lease liability, and no lease schedule is supplied.
No income tax in either TB for a Ltd company (9m 2025 profit 594,241; FY2024 614,939), and no tax data supplied for the tax note.
Issue date 20 March 2026 for a 30 September 2025 period is implausible for interim accounts; the key's 'window runs to 20 March 2026' rests on it.
summary: PASS 3/3: Sep-2024 TB rejected on content; PP&E and debt notes drafted, contingency and RPs held for input; prior-year notes disagree with the 2024 TB.
